## Summary
- require formal Host RSS readiness evidence to keep install/replace-host and runtime-gate-closure safety flags false
- add regression coverage for those flags being true or missing
- update tools documentation for the stricter readiness safety contract

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_rss_gate -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_rss_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/host_rss_gate.py tools/tests/test_host_rss_gate.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/phase0_stable_release.py tools/tests/test_phase0_stable_release.py
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- git diff --check

## Not run
- Did not start Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI
- Did not run swift run or Host/product self-test
- Did not modify Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, TCC, Keychain, or System Settings
- Did not create adb reverse or run a soak


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Strengthened host readiness validation to reject checks that install or replace the host or close runtime gates.
  * Missing safety declarations now fail closed with an insufficient readiness verdict.

* **Documentation**
  * Clarified that host RSS readiness probes must remain read-only and cannot modify the host or claim runtime gate closure.

title: test: harden Host RSS readiness safety gate
